questions.question: When the apostle Paul was persecuted in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, how did it end for him?

answers.text: The Lord rescued him from all of them
The towns finally welcomed him in
He learned to stay out of trouble

questions.question: In his letter to Timothy, Paul said all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be what?
In his letter to Timothy, where did Paul say all Scripture comes from?
Paul told Timothy that Scripture teaches, corrects and trains. What is all of this meant to do for the man of God?

answers.text: Equip him for every good work
Keep him safe from all hardship
